mejiro_ramonu.slogan: Races with a love supreme… A devilish flower, blooming unrivaled at the top.
mejiro_ramonu.profile: You want to get to know me? Then come to the turf by all means. There you'll learn everything about me... Mejiro Ramonu.
mejiro_ramonu.ears_fact: When she gets a massage, she gets her ears massaged to the tips too.
mejiro_ramonu.family_fact: The wintersweet in their garden is a family favorite.

special_week.slogan: Gonna do 'er best! A naive country girl beelining to her dream.
special_week.profile: My name is Special Week! My dream is to be the best Umamusume in Japan! I'm gonna pull my own weight to make my moms proud!
special_week.ears_fact: They pick up on any sound of cooking.
special_week.tail_fact: She's not very good at playing poker; her tail calls her bluff.
special_week.family_fact: Her eye color came from her birth mother.

silence_suzuka.slogan: The Silent Rider. Aiming to go beyond the speed of sound
silence_suzuka.profile: I'm Silence Suzuka. I like to run. I'm not giving the lead to anyone. Um... That's all.
silence_suzuka.ears_fact: They tune out everything when she's thinking about running.
silence_suzuka.tail_fact: She puts care into it to reduce air resistance.
silence_suzuka.family_fact: They give her extra money for shoes.

tokai_teio.slogan: Invincible and cute! An innocent, hoppin' girl.
tokai_teio.profile: Heya, I'm Tokai Teio! I'm going to be an undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume, so don't let me out of your sight!
tokai_teio.ears_fact: They always pay attention to what the Student Council President says.
tokai_teio.tail_fact: Waves around excitedly when she gets attention.
tokai_teio.family_fact: She cried after trying to not call her parents "mommy" and "daddy".

oguri_cap.slogan: A simple and cool dreamer from the countryside.
oguri_cap.profile: I am Oguri Cap. I'm going to do my best to make everyone in my hometown happy. Please take care of me.
oguri_cap.ears_fact: Can pick out the voices of the people from her hometown in the cheering.
oguri_cap.tail_fact: She has a soft body, so every part of it must be maintained.
oguri_cap.family_fact: Family vacations mean hot springs, and she is a regular at one of the hidden hot springs.

gold_ship.slogan: Rude and unrestrained! An enigmatic golden denpa girl!
gold_ship.profile: Yo, I'm Gold Ship! I don't care if it's on the turf, on fire, or at the edge of the universe. I'm going to find something interesting wherever I can! ☆
gold_ship.ears_fact: Loves to suddenly cover another person's ears and asking "Guess who?".
gold_ship.tail_fact: She sometimes leaves it in her room (according to her).
gold_ship.family_fact: They seem to be a national secret.

mejiro_mcqueen.slogan: Pride of the prestigious Mejiro family. Elegant, determined young lady.
mejiro_mcqueen.profile: My name is Mejiro McQueen. Conquering the "Spring Tennosho" has been a long-cherished goal of the Mejiro family, and I will do it with my own two legs.
mejiro_mcqueen.ears_fact: They tend to stand alert when in front of others.
mejiro_mcqueen.tail_fact: Sways wildly when she's talking about sports.

admire_vega.slogan: Burdened with resolve. A first magnitude star who stays alone.
admire_vega.profile: Admire Vega. ...Can I go now? I need to train more, win more races, and I need to become a first-magnitude star.
admire_vega.ears_fact: They twitch to voices that sound like an older sister.
admire_vega.tail_fact: She has a habit of unconsciously clutching it while sleeping.
admire_vega.family_fact: They prepare two birthday cakes every year.

symboli_rudolf.slogan: The reigning "Emperor", her authority is absolute!
symboli_rudolf.profile: I am Symboli Rudolf. I am the one who will stand at the top of every Umamusume and lead them to become "Emperors". Those of you who share my aspirations, let's work together to conquer the world!
symboli_rudolf.ears_fact: Her ears prick up when she hears a good pun.
symboli_rudolf.tail_fact: When she's giving a speech, every strand of hair is powerful.
symboli_rudolf.family_fact: Her parents taught her Imperialism from a young age.

kitasan_black.slogan: She lights up our hearts! A cheerful and lively festival girl!
kitasan_black.profile: I'm Kitasan Black! I'm going to run as fast as I can to make this race as exciting as a festival!
kitasan_black.weaknesses: Turning a blind eye to things
kitasan_black.ears_fact: She has an excellent sense of sound.
kitasan_black.tail_fact: Even her tail can hold heavy things.
kitasan_black.family_fact: A family of 30 people, including her father's disciples, live with her.

satono_diamond.slogan: Diamond-grade core! A young lady who defies jinxes!
satono_diamond.profile: My name is Satono Diamond. My fate has never been decided from the beginning. I will make the future shine with my running!
satono_diamond.family_fact: Her father is a distinguished man and a philanthropist in the Umamusume world.

vodka.slogan: Runaway youth! A pure-hearted, delinquent roadster
vodka.profile: Yo, I'm Vodka! My goal is to be the coolest Umamusume in the world! I'm not gonna do anything stupid. Remember that!
vodka.strengths: Acting like she's riding a motorcycle
vodka.ears_fact: She gets really shy when someone touches them.
vodka.tail_fact: She practices shaking it to look cool.
vodka.family_fact: Her and her dad are very mischievous together, they get scolded by her mom a lot.

daiwa_scarlet.slogan: Self-important! A girl with a competitive streak!
daiwa_scarlet.profile: Hello, I'm Daiwa Scarlet! I'll do my best to... Hmph! I'm going to be number one. That's all!
daiwa_scarlet.ears_fact: They unconsciously reveal her true feelings.
daiwa_scarlet.tail_fact: She struggles to brush it every morning.
daiwa_scarlet.family_fact: She misses her mother, who's always enthusiastic about her racing

grass_wonder.slogan: Neat and pretty. The ideal Japanese woman from America.
grass_wonder.profile: My name is Grass Wonder. Since I was born as a Umamusume, I want to pursue this path to the end. Hehe ♪
grass_wonder.strengths: Japanese sweets, Japanese culture in general, competitive karuta.
grass_wonder.ears_fact: They don't move an inch when she's making tea.
grass_wonder.tail_fact: Able to swat bugs without looking behind her.
grass_wonder.family_fact: "My parents influenced my love for Japan. They have a Japanese-style room in their house."

el_condor_pasa.slogan: Mystery North American bird! The cheerful and eccentric lucha libre
el_condor_pasa.profile: I'm the crimson bird that runs the course! El Condor Pasa is closing in! I'm flying around the world!
el_condor_pasa.ears_fact: She goes on the defense when she hears the wrestling count.
el_condor_pasa.tail_fact: Grabbing her tail is an automatic foul.
el_condor_pasa.family_fact: She grew up with a hawk named Mambo. He's like her sibling.

mejiro_ryan.slogan: She feels fresh and sporty! Even her glistening sweat is pure.
mejiro_ryan.profile: My name is Mejiro Ryan! Train your body, stay healthy! Grow some muscle, stay fit! Let's go for it!
mejiro_ryan.ears_fact: They twitch around a lot when she's reading shoujo manga.
mejiro_ryan.tail_fact: She sweats a lot, so she always has a towel for her tail.
mejiro_ryan.family_fact: Her father is very young and is often mistaken for her brother.

rice_shower.slogan: Unhappy disposition? A sorrowful maiden who lives a praiseworthy life.
rice_shower.profile: I'm... Rice Shower. Um... I'm a useless girl who makes others unhappy... but I'm trying my best to change!
rice_shower.ears_fact: They droop when she hears about other's unhappiness.
rice_shower.tail_fact: She pays attention not to bump it into people.
rice_shower.family_fact: She used to fall asleep listening to her parents read picture books.

maruzensky.profile: Hi, I'm Maruzensky! Did you come to see this new style of running too? Hehe ♪ Even though I'm crazy about it... I don't know how to feel ♪
maruzensky.ears_fact: Listening to Eurobeat makes her want to drive faster.
maruzensky.tail_fact: She likes to shampoo her hair in the morning to make it smooth and silky.
maruzensky.family_fact: She drives her father's second-hand red supercar.

taiki_shuttle.profile: Howdy! I'm Taiki Shuttle! I'm here to make everyone happy with my powerful running!
taiki_shuttle.ears_fact: Whenever she hears about a party, she runs to it.
taiki_shuttle.tail_fact: She has her tail spray mailed to her.
taiki_shuttle.family_fact: My parents always welcome fireworks in the house.

air_groove.slogan: Level-headed "Empress",a talented and colorful career lady!
air_groove.profile: I am Air Groove. If you don't bend your beliefs, your ideals will surely sprout. To demonstrate this, I, the Empress, will be the guiding light for everyone.
air_groove.ears_fact: They droop gently when tending to flowers.
air_groove.tail_fact: She uses the same tail oil as her mother.
air_groove.family_fact: She spends all year meticulously planning her mother's birthday party.

mihono_bourbon.slogan: Your orders will be strictly followed! Cyborg Umamusume.
mihono_bourbon.profile: My name is Mihono Bourbon. My goal is locked onto becoming a Triple Crown Umamusume. Please refer to my data for legwork and other information.
mihono_bourbon.ears_fact: She wakes up instantly when commanded, even when in a deep sleep.
mihono_bourbon.tail_fact: Rumor has it that she has enough strength to stand on her own tail...
mihono_bourbon.family_fact: Her family is living in an old-fashioned home because of the frequent breakage of household appliances.

super_creek.slogan: A gentle older sister who can heal you with her calm, motherly nature.
super_creek.profile: Tee-hee... I'm Super Creek~ I'll do my best to make everyone smile. Please leave it to me ♪
super_creek.ears_fact: She's good at cleaning other's ears, but not getting her ears cleaned.
super_creek.tail_fact: It's great at soothing small children.
super_creek.family_fact: Her family's day-care center has a reputation for making people feel at home.

seiun_sky.slogan: My pace, my life. Like a drifting cloud...
seiun_sky.profile: Yahoo-, it's Seiun Sky. Take your time and relax... When you're aiming for a big goal, it's important to take your time, right?
seiun_sky.weaknesses: Small, cramped places (The gate, the gate!)
seiun_sky.ears_fact: When they stand on edge, it's meaningful.
seiun_sky.tail_fact: Naturally well-done without tending to it.
seiun_sky.family_fact: When she goes home, she goes fishing with her grandfather and his fishing buddies.

haru_urara.slogan: She has lots of losses, but won't lose hope! The girl who never gives up!
haru_urara.profile: I'm Haru Urara! I love carrots and I lo~ve running because it's fun!♪ I'm going to try my very best to finish first!
haru_urara.ears_fact: Hard words go in the right and come out the left.
haru_urara.tail_fact: She thought spinning it would make her go faster.
haru_urara.family_fact: Her favorite dish is her mother's carrot rice.

nice_nature.slogan: Expectations? No, thank you! A cynical girl.
nice_nature.profile: Uh... I'm Nice Nature. I guess I don't really live up to the name of "Nice Nature", haha... Let's take it easy, shall we?
nice_nature.strengths: Table tennis, searching for tasty snacks
nice_nature.ears_fact: They tend to react when she hears the word "nee-chan".
nice_nature.tail_fact: She takes care of it in the middle of the night in secret.
nice_nature.family_fact: Her parents' snack bar is decorated with articles about their daughter.

king_halo.slogan: A domineering young lady. Her pride is higher than the sky!
king_halo.profile: Ohhh-ho-ho! My name is King Halo. As a first-class Umamusume, I'll give you the best results... And show the world this talent of mine!
king_halo.weaknesses: Crowds, heat, etc. aren't appropriate for the King
king_halo.ears_fact: They don't want to hear anything other than topics adequate for the first-class.
king_halo.tail_fact: Her tail wagging is always top-notch.
king_halo.family_fact: Her mother is catastrophically incapable of housework, so she has servants.

agnes_tachyon.slogan: A Forbidden Mad Scientist. Physical research is everything!
agnes_tachyon.profile: Aren't you interested about how fast a Umamusume can go? If you are, I, Agnes Tachyon, would like you to be my guinea pig.
agnes_tachyon.ears_fact: She refuses to be touched on the ears or forehead.
agnes_tachyon.tail_fact: When she gets an idea, her tail stands on end.
agnes_tachyon.family_fact: The unorthodox child of a family with a spectacular reputation in the racing world.

winning_ticket.slogan: Laugh and cry to your heart's content! An honest girl who's true to her feelings.
winning_ticket.profile: My... My... My dream is to be a Derby Umamusume! And then there's... ah! My name!!!! My name is Winning Ticket! Nice to meet you!
winning_ticket.strengths: Full of support, full of emotion
winning_ticket.ears_fact: According to her best friend, "Even her ear movement is annoying".
winning_ticket.tail_fact: Expressions of joy, anger, grief, and pleasure are always visible.
winning_ticket.family_fact: Watching the Derby together is the most important family event of all.

sakura_bakushin_o.slogan: The great and reckless class president. She's always on the move!
sakura_bakushin_o.profile: Hello! My name is Sakura Bakushin O! As you can see, I am a brilliant class representative! Let's set a great example for everyone! BAKUSHIIIN!
sakura_bakushin_o.weaknesses: Things that require more than 3 steps
sakura_bakushin_o.ears_fact: She only hears half of what people are saying.
sakura_bakushin_o.tail_fact: When she's rushing, you can't even catch the tips of her tail.
sakura_bakushin_o.family_fact: Her family's motto is "Praise, praise, praise, and praise!".

matikanefukukitaru.weight: Today's fortune was "Bad", so slight decrease
matikanefukukitaru.slogan: Come, good fortune! A divination-loving happy-go-lucky girl.
matikanefukukitaru.profile: Hello! They call me Matikanefukukitaru! I believe in the divine messages of Shiraoki-sama, and I constantly am working on my fortune telling, waiting for the day I'll be blessed with good fortune!
matikanefukukitaru.ears_fact: She will sometimes use them to point while fortune-telling.
matikanefukukitaru.tail_fact: Will suddenly stop moving during a fortune-telling session.
matikanefukukitaru.family_fact: Like an excellent older sister, she admires her younger sister's cheerfulness.

twin_turbo.slogan: Turbo full throttle! An explosive Umamusume who knows no limits!
twin_turbo.profile: Twin Turbo! I'll take the first Turbo, I'll take it for sure! Let's go, Turbo, full throttle!!!
twin_turbo.ears_fact: Twitch ever more happily the more she's ran down.
twin_turbo.tail_fact: Wags all over the place, never staying still.
twin_turbo.family_fact: Her parents found their frail daughter's recklessness to be an indication of growth.

ikuno_dictus.slogan: A thorough managing principle. A capable Umamusume who combines hot with cold.
ikuno_dictus.profile: My name is Ikuno Dictus. If you are looking for management, leave it to me. I will manage you thoroughly with an iron will.
ikuno_dictus.ears_fact: The fur on both ears always matches exactly.
ikuno_dictus.tail_fact: She uses it to point at things.
ikuno_dictus.family_fact: She tends to lead family meetings.

biwa_hayahide.slogan: Passionate intellect. Use logic as your weapon!
biwa_hayahide.profile: I'm Biwa Hayahide. My goal is to assemble the perfect winning formula. ...Also, I have a normal-sized head!
biwa_hayahide.ears_fact: As a child, she was sensitive to noises and was often startled by them.
biwa_hayahide.tail_fact: When it's damp, she has a hard time getting her tail into the tail hole of her clothes.
biwa_hayahide.family_fact: Her mother and her sister used to have matching hairstyles.

narita_taishin.slogan: Cool and dry! Even though she's small, she still wins.
narita_taishin.profile: Narita Taishin. That's all. I just want to win and shove it in the faces of the ones who made fun of me... Leave me alone.
narita_taishin.ears_fact: They only turn towards topics that interest her.
narita_taishin.tail_fact: Flicks when touched by anyone other than a trusted friend.
narita_taishin.family_fact: Rumor has it that the moms of BNW are friends now.

mayano_top_gun.slogan: A sweet little sister. She can't wait to grow up!
mayano_top_gun.profile: Ehehe, I'm Mayachin!☆ I love thrilling and exciting things~ Nice to meetcha!
mayano_top_gun.ears_fact: She doesn't listen to things that she doesn't want to hear.
mayano_top_gun.tail_fact: It swishes around a lot when she lies.
mayano_top_gun.family_fact: Her father was a pilot, so the airport was her playground.

tazuna.slogan: Secretary to the Tracen Academy President with a beautiful smile.
tazuna.profile: Hello, I am Tazuna Hayakawa, secretary to the president of Tracen Academy. I will continue to support you so that you can have a better school life.
